settings.engineLiteHelp: Satr oxiridagi bo'shliqlarni qirqadi, takrorlanuvchi bo'sh satrlarni birlashtiradi va takrorlangan tizim xabarlarini olib tashlaydi.
settings.engineReadLifecycleHelp: Xuddi shu fayl keyinroq qayta o'qilgach yoki tahrirlangach, oldingi fayl o'qishini qisqa izoh bilan almashtiradi.
settings.engineToolfilterHelp: Qurish, test va o'rnatish kabi buyruq va vosita chiqishlarini qisqartiradi. Xato va stek izi satrlari doim saqlanadi.
settings.engineJsoncompactHelp: Bir xil maydonlarga ega uzun JSON massivlarini ixcham jadval sifatida qayta kodlaydi. Qaytarib bo'ladi, shuning uchun hech narsa yo'qolmaydi.

settings.engineHardBudgetHelp: So'rov token maqsadiga sig'guncha eng kam qimmatli satrlarni olib tashlaydi.

settings.compressionAutoTriggerHelp: Taxminan shu tokenlar sonidan oshgan so'rovlar avtomatik ravishda Agressiv rejimga o'tadi. O'chirish uchun bo'sh qoldiring.
settings.compressionPrefixFreezeHelp: Bir xil matn uch marta uchraganidan so'ng tizim promptini o'zgarishsiz qoldiradi, shunda provayder tomonidagi prompt keshlash ishlashda davom etadi.
settings.compressionTrustProjectFiltersHelp: Vosita chiqishi filtrlarini ish katalogidan ham yuklaydi. Sukut bo'yicha o'chirilgan, chunki repozitoriy undan modeldan chiqishni yashirish uchun foydalanishi mumkin.

strategies.exploreHint: Give models with no reliability or speed data a 10% chance to go first so they build a track record. Your real request is what gets sent, so it may be answered by an untested model. For a custom endpoint, use Probe endpoint on the Keys page to test it without live traffic.
strategies.keySelectionHint: Bitta provayderning bir nechta kaliti orasidan qanday tanlanadi. Avtomatik joriy navbatni saqlaydi; Eng kam qolgan kalitlarni kuzatilgan kvota bo‘yicha tartiblaydi va eng ko‘p qolgan kalitni birinchi sinaydi.
strategies.peakActiveHint: Eng band soatlar moslashuvi hozir yoqilgan, shuning uchun bular andozaning oʻz vaznlari emas: tezlik vaznining 60% ishonchlilikka koʻchirilgan.
strategies.peakAdjustHint: Standart holatda oʻchiq. Quyidagi oraliqda tezlik vaznining 60% ishonchlilikka koʻchadi — bepul relelar oʻsha paytda eng band boʻladi, shuning uchun ishonchlilik muvaffaqiyatni sof oʻtkazuvchanlikdan koʻra yaxshiroq bashorat qiladi. «Eng tez» va «Eng ishonchli» oʻzgarmaydi.
strategies.peakExemptNote: Bu andoza oʻzgarmaydi — u allaqachon tezlik/ishonchlilik muvozanatining bir chetida turibdi.
strategies.title: Marshrut strategiyasi
strategies.description: Marshrutlash strategiyasini tanlang. Qo'l rejimida tartibni o'rnatish uchun sudrang; Boshqa strategiyalar ishonchlilik, tezlik va aql bo'yicha jonli hisob bilan yo'naltiriladi.
strategies.guardrailsTooltip: Har doim to'siqlar: bepul kvota bo'sh joy × jonli tarif chegarasi uchun jarima. 1.0 dan past bo'lsa, bu model ushlab turilishini anglatadi.
strategies.scoreTooltip: Yakuniy marshrutlash balli = uchta o'qning o'rtacha og'irligi, to'siqlar bilan ko'paytiriladi. Avval yuqori marshrutlar.
strategies.modeManualHint: Qo'l rejimi: so'rovlar quyidagi tartibda, yuqoridan pastgacha. Qayta tartiblash uchun torting.
strategies.modeScoreHint: Jonli trafikdan olingan ballar yangilanadi. Quyida so'rovlar qanday yo'naltirilganligi ko'rsatilgan.
strategies.manualBlurb: Marshrutni quyida o'rnatgan aniq tartibda belgilang. Qayta tartiblash uchun tutqichlarni torting. ball yo'q; zanjir yuqoridan pastgacha kuzatiladi.
strategies.balancedBlurb: Ishonchlilik yetakchilik qiladi (50%), tezlik va aql bir xilda (har biri 25%). Oqilona har tomonlama sukut.
strategies.smartestBlurb: Hali ham ishlaydigan eng qobiliyatli modelga ustunlik bering. Intellekt 55%, ishonchlilik 35%, tezlik 10%.
strategies.fastestBlurb: Hali ham ishlaydigan eng tezkor modelga ustunlik bering. Tezlik 55%, ishonchlilik 35%, aql 10%.
strategies.reliableBlurb: Muvaffaqiyat darajasini eng yuqori darajaga ko'taring. Ishonchlilik 70%, tezlik va aql 15%.
strategies.customBlurb: Slayderlar yordamida ishonchlilik, tezlik va aqlning o'z balansini o'rnating. Oldindan o'rnatilgan dvigatel bilan bir xil, faqat sizning og'irliklaringiz.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Save the routing data to a .sql file beside the database, and restore it later.
backups.excludedNote: A backup carries your providers, models, routing settings and request history. Accounts, sessions and URL tokens are never included, so a dump holds no password hashes or login tokens and restoring one cannot log you out. Provider keys stay encrypted with this server's ENCRYPTION_KEY: a backup can only be restored on a server that still holds that key.

backups.autoHint: The server writes a full backup on this cadence.
backups.pathHint: Relative to the database directory. Backups cannot be written outside it.

descriptions.claude: Anthropic's terminal agent: it plans, edits files, and runs commands in your repo.
descriptions.codex: OpenAI's terminal agent, which runs your task in a local sandbox first.
descriptions.cline: A VS Code extension that asks you to approve every edit and command.
descriptions.continue: A VS Code and JetBrains extension for inline autocomplete and chat while you type.
descriptions.aider: A command-line pair programmer that turns each change into its own git commit.
descriptions.opencode: A provider-agnostic terminal agent with a full-screen text interface.
descriptions.goose: Block's local agent, extended with MCP servers to reach past your code.
descriptions.qwen: A Gemini CLI fork tuned for Qwen models and large repositories.
descriptions.roo: A VS Code extension with switchable modes: architect, coder, debugger.
descriptions.kilo: A VS Code extension merging Roo and Cline, with an orchestrator that splits up work.
descriptions.crush: Charm's terminal agent, written in Go, with one session per project.
descriptions.dsh: DeepSeek's harness, which keeps every provider as a route you can switch between.
descriptions.mimo: Xiaomi's terminal agent, an OpenCode fork that takes any OpenAI-compatible provider.
descriptions.cursor: The AI-first editor; it calls through Cursor's cloud, so it needs a public URL.
descriptions.generic: Anything else that speaks the OpenAI API, set up by hand from a base URL and key.
descriptions.atomcode: AtomGit's terminal agent, written in Rust, that takes any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
